why: Every item a lesson unlocks that the same lesson's own exercises never ask about — the per-item practice debt behind APP_PLAN W04, and the work list the W20 per-item practice campaign consumes. Regenerated by scripts/validate/validate_practice_coverage.py; the counts are ratcheted in scripts/validate/practice_coverage_baseline.json and may not grow.
definition: An unlocked item is practised when an exercise of its own lesson TARGETS it: the item appears in an answer surface (text/full/correct/accept/order/pairs), in <vocab|kanji|grammar ref> markup in the prompt, or in a sentence the exercise cites via sentence_refs (token vocab slugs, grammar tags, token surfaces for kanji). Distractors, the explanation field and incidental Japanese in the prompt do not count. Vocab matches by longest-match tiling, kanji by character containment, grammar by pattern-segment match.
order: course order (level, topic number, lesson order); re-sort by absent_count for worst-first
